Class BattleOfWallRose

java.lang.Object
BattleOfWallRose
public class BattleOfWallRose extends Object
Master Tactical Command system coordinating the defense of Wall Rose. Orchestrates interaction between WallDistrict, ScoutSquad, and TitanShifter (including its inner classes).
Author:
Commander Erwin Smith & Survey Corps Command

    • executeDefenseOperation

      public boolean executeDefenseOperation(String commandSignal, String hexIntel)
      Master Execution Method: Coordinates the comprehensive military operation to defend Wall Rose against the titan assault. Operational Workflow: 1. Signal Intelligence: For each registered district, decodes the radio signals using district.decodeSignal(commandSignal, hexIntel). Adds the decoded urgency level and titan count to totalHumanityDefenseScore. 2. District Kill Matrices: Tallies confirmed kills using district.calculateTotalConfirmedKills() and adds to totalHumanityDefenseScore. 3. Titan Engagement: Checks if the district has a spottedTitan: - If the spotted titan is hostile: - Searches for an undeployed squad in activeSquads that can engage the titan. - If a squad can engage, marks it deployed (sets deployed to true) and adds its squadPower to totalHumanityDefenseScore. - If no squad can engage alone, calls on a friendly shifter (using findFriendlyShifter()): Creates an inner class transformation: TitanShifter.TitanForm form = friendly.new TitanForm("2"); Retrieves the power surge via form.getPowerSurge() and boosts the first squad's power. Marks that squad as deployed and adds its updated squadPower to totalHumanityDefenseScore. Assesses combat readiness via TitanShifter.assessCombatReadiness(friendly.getPowerLevel()) and adds the calculated readiness score (index 0). - If the spotted titan is friendly (not hostile): - Triggers the Coordinate ability via static nested class: TitanShifter.CoordinatePower.triggerCoordinate(spottedTitan, commandSignal). - If activated, adds the controlled titans count to totalHumanityDefenseScore. 4. Outcome Assessment: Returns true if totalHumanityDefenseScore >= 100 (Wall Rose successfully secured), otherwise false.
      Parameters:
      commandSignal - binary operational command signal (e.g. "1010")
      hexIntel - hexadecimal intel report (e.g. "FF")
      Returns:
      true if humanity's defense succeeds (score >= 100), false otherwise
